"""Exact C227749 Native crossing runner; --check is CPU only."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree

from crossing_geometry import validate_scene
from native_capture import FourVideoRecorder, sample_original_walker
from native_controller import request_next_control, spawn_walker
from native_crosswalk_readback import audit_crosswalk_map
from reviewed_site import audit_reviewed_site

FRAMES=400
CAMERAS=('overview','approach','reference_corner','driver_reference')

def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write(path,value):Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')

def check_scene(scene_path,map_path):
    scene=json.loads(Path(scene_path).read_text());validate_scene(scene)
    if sha(map_path)!=scene.get('map_source_sha256'):
        raise ValueError('source-hashed exact OpenDRIVE differs')
    xml=ElementTree.parse(map_path).getroot()
    if xml.tag!='OpenDRIVE' or not xml.findall('./road/planView/geometry/line'):
        raise ValueError('candidate OpenDRIVE road line missing')
    roads=xml.findall('./road')
    if len(roads)!=1:
        raise ValueError('single authored crossing road required')
    geometry=roads[0].find('./planView/geometry')
    if geometry is None or any(abs(float(geometry.attrib.get(key,'nan'))-value)>1e-9
                               for key,value in (('x',0),('y',3),('hdg',0))):
        raise ValueError('authored crossing road reference differs')
    crosswalks=roads[0].findall('./objects/object[@type="crosswalk"]')
    if len(crosswalks)!=1:
        raise ValueError('one authored OpenDRIVE crosswalk object required')
    object_vertices=[]
    for corner in crosswalks[0].findall('./outline/cornerRoad'):
        object_vertices.append([float(corner.attrib['s']),3+float(corner.attrib['t'])])
    expected=scene['crosswalk_boundaries_xy_m']
    if len(expected)!=1 or len(object_vertices)!=len(expected[0]) or sorted(object_vertices)!=sorted(expected[0]):
        raise ValueError('authored OpenDRIVE crosswalk differs from exact scene')
    return scene

def _trace(actor,sample):
    pose=actor.get_transform();velocity=actor.get_velocity();control=actor.get_control()
    values=[float(v) for v in (pose.location.x,pose.location.y,pose.location.z,
      pose.rotation.yaw,velocity.x,velocity.y,velocity.z,
      control.direction.x,control.direction.y,control.direction.z,control.speed)]
    if not all(map(math.isfinite,values)):
        raise ValueError('nonfinite original walker telemetry')
    x,y,z,yaw,vx,vy,vz,dx,dy,dz,speed=values
    return {'frame':sample['frame'],'time_s':sample['time_s'],'actor_id':sample['actor_id'],
       'position_m':[x,y,z],'position':{'x':x,'y':y,'z':z},'heading_deg':yaw,
       'velocity_mps':[vx,vy,vz],'speed_mps':math.sqrt(vx*vx+vy*vy+vz*vz),
       'speed_mph':math.sqrt(vx*vx+vy*vy+vz*vz)/.44704,'control':{},
       'walker_control':{'direction_xyz':[dx,dy,dz],'requested_speed_mps':speed,
                         'jump':bool(control.jump)}}

def run_native(scene,scene_path,map_path,output,host,port):
    repo=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    safe=(repo/'.runtime-work').resolve()
    output=Path(output).resolve()
    if not output.is_dir() or not output.is_relative_to(safe):
        raise ValueError('fresh attempt must be under .runtime-work')
    if Path(scene_path).resolve()!=output/'scene.json' or Path(map_path).resolve()!=output/'candidate-crossing.xodr':
        raise ValueError('exact materialized scene/map required')
    if not (output/'construction.json').is_file() or not (output/'config.json').is_file():
        raise ValueError('exact materialized construction/config required')
    if any((output/name).exists() for name in ('trace.jsonl','video_frames.jsonl','walker-body-history.jsonl','capture-seal.json')):
        raise ValueError('original acquisition already exists')
    reviewed = audit_reviewed_site(scene, output)
    write(output/'reviewed-site-audit.json', reviewed)
    os.environ['SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT']=str(safe/'c227749-native-runtime')
    import carla
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap,seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot as snapshot_world,restore
    from walker_pipeline_capture import WalkerPipelineCapture
    client=carla.Client(host,port);client.set_timeout(30)
    previous=snapshot_world(client)
    world=actor=videos=capture=frame_map=None
    frames=[];errors=[];restoration={'restored':False}
    try:
        world=client.generate_opendrive_world(Path(map_path).read_text())
        write(output/'native-crosswalk-readback.json',
              audit_crosswalk_map(scene,world.get_map()))
        settings=world.get_settings();settings.synchronous_mode=True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds=.05;settings.no_rendering_mode=False
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        actor=spawn_walker(world,carla,scene)
        write(output/'acquisition-provenance.json',{'provenance_kind':'native',
              'diagnostic_fixture':False,'case_id':scene['case_id'],
              'map_sha256':sha(map_path),'method':'original walker body, telemetry and four RGB cameras'})
        videos=FourVideoRecorder(world,scene,carla,output)
        capture=WalkerPipelineCapture(client,actor,output,scene['case_id'])
        frame_map=FrameMap(output/'video_frames.jsonl')
        index=1
        with (output/'walker-body-history.jsonl').open('x',buffering=1) as body, \
             (output/'camera-frame-joins.jsonl').open('x',buffering=1) as joins:
            for _ in range(FRAMES):
                index=request_next_control(actor,carla,scene,index)
                frame=world.tick();snapshot=world.get_snapshot()
                if frame!=snapshot.frame:raise RuntimeError('Native tick/snapshot frame mismatch')
                sample=sample_original_walker(scene,actor,snapshot)
                camera_join=videos.append(sample)
                captured=capture.capture(frame,sample['time_s'],sample)
                if captured['frame']!=frame:raise RuntimeError('canonical graph/body frame mismatch')
                frame_map.append(frame,sample['time_s'])
                body.write(json.dumps(sample,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                joins.write(json.dumps(camera_join,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                frames.append(frame)
    except BaseException as error:
        errors.append(repr(error))
    finally:
        for resource in (frame_map,capture,videos):
            if resource is not None:
                try:
                    if resource is capture:resource.close(confirmed=not errors)
                    else:resource.close()
                except BaseException as error:errors.append(repr(error))
        if actor is not None:
            try:actor.destroy()
            except BaseException as error:errors.append(repr(error))
        try:restoration=restore(client,previous)
        except BaseException as error:errors.append('world restoration: '+repr(error))
    if errors or not restoration.get('restored'):
        write(output/'native-run-status.json',{'phase':'failed','errors':errors,
             'restoration':restoration,'captured_frames':len(frames)})
        raise RuntimeError('Native acquisition or restoration failed; retained failed attempt')
    sources=('scene.json','candidate-crossing.xodr','reviewed-site.json','reviewed-site-audit.json',
             'native-crosswalk-readback.json','road.xodr','trace.jsonl',
             'walker-body-history.jsonl','video_frames.jsonl','camera-frame-joins.jsonl',
             *(name+'.mkv' for name in CAMERAS))
    sources += tuple(ref['path'] for ref in reviewed['source_refs'].values())
    write(output/'acquisition.json',{name:{'kind':'original_native','sha256':sha(output/name)} for name in dict.fromkeys(sources)})
    seal_capture(output,frames=len(frames),restoration=restoration,errors=[],
       encoder_exit_codes={name:0 for name in CAMERAS},
       context={'case_id':scene['case_id'],'map_sha256':scene['map_source_sha256']})
    return {'case_id':scene['case_id'],'frames':len(frames),
            'native_acquisition_sealed':True,'physical_acceptance_claimed':False}

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--scene',default='scene.json')
    parser.add_argument('--map',default='candidate-crossing.xodr')
    parser.add_argument('--check',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir');parser.add_argument('--host',default='127.0.0.1')
    parser.add_argument('--port',type=int,default=2000)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    scene=check_scene(args.scene,args.map)
    if args.check:print(json.dumps({'case_id':scene['case_id'],'static_construction_valid':True,
                      'planned_frames':FRAMES,'native_started':False,
                      'physical_crosswalk_readback':'pending'}))
    elif args.output_dir:print(json.dumps(run_native(scene,args.scene,args.map,
                                                     args.output_dir,args.host,args.port)))
    else:parser.error('use --check or --output-dir')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Compare authored crosswalk vertices with the loaded Native map readback.

Matching vertices are a geometry prerequisite, not proof of paint visibility,
curb identity, municipal jurisdiction, or a legal route classification.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math

from crossing_geometry import point, validate_scene


def audit_crosswalk_map(scene, map_obj, vertex_tolerance_m=0.5):
    validate_scene(scene)
    if not isinstance(vertex_tolerance_m, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(vertex_tolerance_m) or not 0 < vertex_tolerance_m <= 1:
        raise ValueError('Native crosswalk vertex tolerance invalid')
    original_xodr = map_obj.to_opendrive()
    if not isinstance(original_xodr, str) or not original_xodr:
        raise ValueError('loaded Native OpenDRIVE missing')
    loaded_hash = hashlib.sha256(original_xodr.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
    if loaded_hash != scene.get('map_source_sha256'):
        raise ValueError('loaded Native map source differs from exact scene')
    observed = map_obj.get_crosswalks()
    if not isinstance(observed, (list, tuple)) or len(observed) < 4:
        raise ValueError('Native crosswalk vertex readback missing')
    vertices = []
    for location in observed:
        xyz = (float(location.x), float(location.y), float(location.z))
        if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in xyz):
            raise ValueError('nonfinite Native crosswalk vertex')
        vertices.append([xyz[0], xyz[1]])
    polygon_matches = []
    for polygon in scene['crosswalk_boundaries_xy_m']:
        matched = []
        for raw in polygon:
            authored = point(raw)
            distance = min(math.dist(authored, candidate) for candidate in vertices)
            if distance > vertex_tolerance_m:
                raise ValueError('authored crosswalk vertex absent from Native map')
            matched.append(distance)
        polygon_matches.append({'vertices': len(polygon),
                                'maximum_vertex_readback_gap_m': max(matched)})
    return {'case_id': scene['case_id'], 'loaded_map_sha256': loaded_hash,
            'native_crosswalk_vertices': len(vertices),
            'authored_polygon_readbacks': polygon_matches,
            'curb_identity': 'unverified', 'paint_visibility': 'unverified',
            'municipal_jurisdiction': 'unverified',
            'legal_route_classification': 'unresolved'}

"""Lazy CARLA walker construction for authored pedestrian route targets."""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

from crossing_geometry import validate_scene, point


def spawn_walker(world, carla, scene, blueprint_id='walker.pedestrian.0001'):
    validate_scene(scene)
    blueprints = world.get_blueprint_library()
    blueprint = blueprints.find(blueprint_id)
    x, y = point(scene['route_xy_m'][0])
    location = carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=float(scene.get('spawn_height_m', 0.3)))
    actor = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint, carla.Transform(location))
    if actor is None:
        raise RuntimeError('pedestrian spawn failed')
    got = actor.get_transform().location
    if math.dist((got.x, got.y), (x, y)) > 0.5:
        actor.destroy()
        raise RuntimeError('walker spawn readback outside engineering tolerance')
    return actor


def request_next_control(actor, carla, scene, target_index, speed_mps=1.2):
    """Request motion only; actual progress must come from original body history."""
    validate_scene(scene)
    route = [point(p) for p in scene['route_xy_m']]
    if not 1 <= target_index < len(route):
        raise ValueError('target index out of range')
    loc = actor.get_transform().location
    at = (float(loc.x), float(loc.y))
    if math.dist(at, route[target_index]) <= 0.4 and target_index + 1 < len(route):
        target_index += 1
    target = route[target_index]
    dx, dy = target[0]-at[0], target[1]-at[1]
    distance = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    if not math.isfinite(distance) or not math.isfinite(speed_mps) or speed_mps <= 0:
        raise ValueError('invalid walker target or speed')
    speed = 0.0 if distance <= 0.15 else float(speed_mps)
    direction = carla.Vector3D(x=dx/distance, y=dy/distance, z=0) if distance else carla.Vector3D(x=0,y=0,z=0)
    control = carla.WalkerControl(direction=direction, speed=speed, jump=False)
    actor.apply_control(control)
    return target_index

"""Walker telemetry adapter for the pinned original scene graph capture.

PipelineCapture owns the native recorder, map facts, graph collector and trace.
This override records WalkerControl explicitly instead of reading vehicle-only
throttle, brake and gear fields from a pedestrian actor.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import time

from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture, xyz


class WalkerPipelineCapture(PipelineCapture):
    def capture(self, frame, time_s, walker_sample):
        if self.closed or self.world.get_snapshot().frame != frame:
            raise RuntimeError("walker graph capture must observe the current original frame")
        if walker_sample["frame"] != frame or abs(walker_sample["time_s"]-time_s) > 1e-6:
            raise ValueError("walker body and graph frame identity differ")
        transform = self.ego.get_transform()
        velocity = self.ego.get_velocity()
        control = self.ego.get_control()
        speed = math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2)
        position = xyz(transform.location)
        walker_control = {"direction_xyz": xyz(control.direction),
                          "requested_speed_mps": float(control.speed),
                          "jump": bool(control.jump)}
        row = {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s,
               "actor_id": walker_sample["actor_id"],
               "position": dict(zip(("x", "y", "z"), position)),
               "position_m": position, "heading_deg": transform.rotation.yaw,
               "speed_mps": speed, "speed_mph": speed/.44704,
               "velocity_mps": xyz(velocity), "control": {},
               "walker_control": walker_control}
        from original_observations import observe
        started = time.perf_counter()
        observations = observe(self.world, self.ego, frame, time_s,
                               self.user_visibility, self.physical_registry)
        observations["map_context"] = self.map_context
        subject = next((item for item in observations["participants"]
                        if item["actor_id"] == self.ego.id), None)
        if subject is None:
            raise RuntimeError("original participant inventory omits walker")
        for key in ("accel_longitudinal_mps2", "acceleration_method",
                    "acceleration_projection", "acceleration_mps2",
                    "forward_vector"):
            if key in subject:
                row[key] = subject[key]
        observation_seconds = time.perf_counter()-started
        graph = self.collector.capture(frame, None, observed_evidence=observations)
        if not graph:
            raise RuntimeError("missing original walker adapter graph frame")
        waypoint = self.map.get_waypoint(transform.location)
        weather = self.world.get_weather()
        event = {"original_frame": frame, "replay_frame": frame,
                 "actor_id": self.ego.id, "recording_time_s": time_s,
                 "replay_simulation_time_s": graph["simulation_time"],
                 "ego": {"position_m": position,
                         "heading_deg": transform.rotation.yaw,
                         "speed_mps": speed,
                         "speed_provenance": "original_trace_actor_get_velocity",
                         "body_vertices_m": [xyz(vertex) for vertex in
                             self.ego.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(transform)]},
                 "world": {"weather": {key: getattr(weather, key) for key in
                     ("cloudiness", "precipitation", "precipitation_deposits",
                      "fog_density", "fog_distance", "sun_altitude_angle", "wetness")},
                     "road_projection": None if waypoint is None else {
                         "road_id": waypoint.road_id,
                         "section_id": waypoint.section_id,
                         "lane_id": waypoint.lane_id, "s_m": waypoint.s}},
                 "original_observations": observations,
                 "timing": {"observation_seconds": observation_seconds,
                            "graph_capture_seconds": graph.get("capture_seconds"),
                            "graph_extraction_seconds": graph.get("extraction_seconds")},
                 "supporting_only": {"applied_walker_control": walker_control}}
        self.trace.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
        self.evidence.write(json.dumps(event, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
        self.meta["frames"] += 1
        return row

"""Independent original walker-body and crosswalk geometry checks.

This establishes sampled physical geometry only. Curb meaning, jurisdiction,
camera visibility and legal route classification require separate review.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

from crossing_geometry import crosswalk_overlap, point, validate_scene


def audit_body_history(scene: dict, rows: list[dict], expected_frames: int = 400) -> dict:
    validate_scene(scene)
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) != expected_frames:
        raise ValueError('complete original walker body duration missing')
    first = rows[0].get('frame')
    first_time = rows[0].get('time_s')
    actor_id = rows[0].get('actor_id')
    if type(first) is not int or type(first_time) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(first_time):
        raise ValueError('original frame or time missing')
    if type(actor_id) is not int:
        raise ValueError('original walker actor missing')
    overlap_frames = []
    centers = []
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        if row.get('frame') != first + index or row.get('actor_id') != actor_id:
            raise ValueError('original walker frame or actor join mismatch')
        time_s = row.get('time_s')
        if type(time_s) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(time_s) or abs(time_s - first_time - index / 20) > 0.001:
            raise ValueError('original walker 20 Hz time join mismatch')
        if row.get('source') != 'original_native' or row.get('source_kind') != 'original_native_world_vertices':
            raise ValueError('original Native body source missing')
        body = row.get('body_xy_m')
        if not isinstance(body, list) or len(body) != 4:
            raise ValueError('four original body corners missing')
        corners = [point(corner) for corner in body]
        if (math.dist(corners[0], corners[1]) < 0.1 or
            math.dist(corners[1], corners[2]) < 0.1):
            raise ValueError('degenerate walker body polygon')
        center = point(row.get('body_center_xy_m'))
        if not (min(x for x, _ in corners) <= center[0] <= max(x for x, _ in corners) and
                min(y for _, y in corners) <= center[1] <= max(y for _, y in corners)):
            raise ValueError('walker center outside body polygon bounds')
        centers.append(list(center))
        if crosswalk_overlap(corners + [corners[0]], scene['crosswalk_boundaries_xy_m']):
            overlap_frames.append(first + index)
    if bool(overlap_frames) != (scene['crosswalk_context'] == 'inside'):
        raise ValueError('original body and crosswalk context disagree')
    return {'case_id': scene['case_id'], 'first_original_frame': first,
            'last_original_frame': first + expected_frames - 1,
            'frame_count': expected_frames, 'actor_id': actor_id,
            'body_crosswalk_overlap_frames': overlap_frames,
            'body_center_first_xy_m': centers[0],
            'body_center_last_xy_m': centers[-1],
            'legal_route_classification': 'unresolved',
            'physical_visibility': 'unconfirmed'}


def evaluate_crossing_completion(scene: dict, rows: list[dict] | None) -> dict:
    """Check measured route completion, leaving legal and image review unresolved.

    The 0.25 m endpoint radius is a walker-control engineering check, not a
    statutory route or curb tolerance. Caller provenance is reported separately.
    """
    method = '400 consecutive 20 Hz original body samples; observed endpoint within 0.25 m of the authored route target'
    sources = ['scene.json', 'walker-body-history.jsonl']
    if not rows:
        return {'maneuver_completed': False,
                'physical_checks': {'maneuver': {'status': 'unverified', 'method': method,
                                                 'sources': sources, 'reason': 'body history missing'}},
                'realized_observables': {}}
    try:
        history = audit_body_history(scene, rows)
    except ValueError as exc:
        return {'maneuver_completed': False,
                'physical_checks': {'maneuver': {'status': 'unverified', 'method': method,
                                                 'sources': sources, 'reason': str(exc)}},
                'realized_observables': {}}
    target = point(scene['route_xy_m'][-1])
    endpoint = history['body_center_last_xy_m']
    distance = math.dist(endpoint, target)
    status = 'met' if distance <= 0.25 else 'not_met'
    return {'maneuver_completed': status == 'met',
            'physical_checks': {'maneuver': {'status': status, 'method': method,
                                             'sources': sources,
                                             'endpoint_distance_m': distance}},
            'realized_observables': {'frame_count': history['frame_count'],
                                     'original_frame_range': [history['first_original_frame'],
                                                              history['last_original_frame']],
                                     'endpoint_distance_m': distance,
                                     'crosswalk_overlap_frames': len(history['body_crosswalk_overlap_frames'])},
            'legal_route_classification': 'unresolved',
            'physical_visibility': 'unconfirmed'}

"""Read-only source-bound crossing measurement from a saved Native attempt."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from delivery_audit import audit_saved, CAMERAS
from physical_geometry_audit import audit_body_history

REQUIRED = ('scene.json', 'walker-body-history.jsonl', 'camera-frame-joins.jsonl',
            *(name + '.mkv' for name in CAMERAS))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line]


def read_attempt(attempt):
    root = Path(attempt).resolve()
    marker_path = root/'acquisition-provenance.json'
    if not marker_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError('Missing required source: acquisition-provenance.json')
    marker = json.loads(marker_path.read_text())
    diagnostic = marker.get('diagnostic_fixture')
    if (marker.get('provenance_kind'), diagnostic) not in (('native', False), ('synthetic_fixture', True)):
        raise ValueError('contradictory acquisition provenance')
    required_kind = 'diagnostic_fixture' if diagnostic else 'original_native'
    index_path = root/'acquisition.json'
    if not index_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError('Missing required source: acquisition.json')
    index = json.loads(index_path.read_text())
    sources = {}
    for name in REQUIRED:
        item = index.get(name)
        path = root/name
        if not path.is_file() or not item:
            raise ValueError('Missing required source: '+name)
        if item.get('kind') != required_kind:
            raise ValueError('source provenance differs: '+name)
        actual = sha(path)
        if item.get('sha256') is not None and item['sha256'] != actual:
            raise ValueError('source hash mismatch: '+name)
        if not diagnostic and not item.get('sha256'):
            raise ValueError('original Native source hash required: '+name)
        sources[name] = actual
    scene = json.loads((root/'scene.json').read_text())
    rows = _rows(root/'walker-body-history.jsonl')
    joins = _rows(root/'camera-frame-joins.jsonl')
    cameras = {name:{**index[name+'.mkv'],'sha256':sources[name+'.mkv']} for name in CAMERAS}
    measurement = audit_saved(scene,rows,joins,cameras,expected_camera_kind=required_kind)
    report = {'format':'worker-pedestrian-crossing-measurement',
            'case_id':scene['case_id'], 'measurement':measurement,
            'sources_sha256':sources, 'legal_verdict_claimed':False,
            'diagnostic_fixture':diagnostic,
            'physical_visibility':'unconfirmed_by_this_measurement'}
    if not diagnostic:
        report['native_body_geometry'] = audit_body_history(scene,rows)
    return report


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--attempt',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    report=read_attempt(args.attempt)
    output=Path(args.output).resolve()
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError('retain prior report; choose a new output')
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'case_id':report['case_id'],'saved_measurement_passed':True}))


if __name__=='__main__': main()

"""Saved-only exact pedestrian crossing measurement and Native-result bridge."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from saved_measurement import read_attempt


def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def measure_crossing_route(attempt):
    """Selected measurement contract method, using original-shaped saved sources."""
    return read_attempt(attempt)['measurement']


def _write_rows(path, rows):
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        for row in rows: stream.write(json.dumps(row,allow_nan=False)+'\n')


def build_report(attempt):
    root=Path(attempt).resolve()
    saved=read_attempt(root)
    scene=json.loads((root/'scene.json').read_text())
    config=json.loads((root/'config.json').read_text())
    if config['selected_case_id']!=scene['case_id'] or saved['case_id']!=scene['case_id']:
        raise ValueError('saved exact case identity mismatch')
    description=config['case']['recording_description']
    trace=[json.loads(line) for line in (root/'trace.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line]
    bodies=[json.loads(line) for line in (root/'walker-body-history.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line]
    if len(trace)!=len(bodies) or any(t.get('frame')!=b.get('frame') or abs(t.get('time_s',-1)-b.get('time_s',0))>1e-4 for t,b in zip(trace,bodies)):
        raise ValueError('original trace and walker body join mismatch')
    values={
      'walker_body_route':[b['body_xy_m'] for b in bodies],
      'curb_and_crosswalk_geometry':[{'starting_curb_xy_m':scene['starting_curb_xy_m'],
          'opposite_curb_xy_m':scene['opposite_curb_xy_m'],
          'crosswalk_boundaries_xy_m':scene['crosswalk_boundaries_xy_m']} for _ in bodies],
      'route_angle_and_length':[saved['measurement'] for _ in bodies],
      'governing_context':[{'control_context':scene['control_context'],
          'jurisdiction_source':scene['jurisdiction_source'],'site_context_status':scene['site_context_status']} for _ in bodies],
    }
    channels=root/'channels';channels.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    evidence=[]
    for item in description['channels']:
        name=item['name']
        if name not in values:raise ValueError('unsupported channel: '+name)
        path=channels/(name+'.jsonl')
        _write_rows(path,[{'time_s':b['time_s'],'value':value} for b,value in zip(bodies,values[name])])
        evidence.append({'name':name,'unit':item['unit'],'reference':str(path.relative_to(root))})
    context={'roadway_and_jurisdiction':{'road_sha256':sha(root/'road.xodr'),
       'site_context_status':scene['site_context_status'],'crosswalk_context':scene['crosswalk_context'],
       'camera_sources_sha256':{name:sha(root/(name+'.mkv')) for name in ('overview','approach','reference_corner','driver_reference')}}}
    context_path=channels/'context.json';context_path.write_text(json.dumps(context,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    for item in description['context_inputs']:
        evidence.append({'name':item['name'],'unit':item['unit'],'reference':str(context_path.relative_to(root))})
    measurement=saved['measurement']
    report={'format':'worker-analysis-report','analysis_complete':True,'case_id':scene['case_id'],
       'provenance_kind':'synthetic_fixture' if saved['diagnostic_fixture'] else 'native',
       'diagnostic_fixture':saved['diagnostic_fixture'],
       'measurements':{'crossing_route_geometry':{'method':'measure_crossing_route','value':measurement,
          'sources':{key:value for key,value in saved['sources_sha256'].items() if key!='scene.json'}}},
       'construction_scene_sha256':saved['sources_sha256']['scene.json'],
       'legal_verdict_claimed':False,
       'limitations':['Authored curb and crosswalk context is not original map confirmation.',
                      'Synthetic diagnostic pixels and motion are software compatibility only.']}
    target={'target':'original walker crossing route measured against sourced curbs',
       'requested':scene['construction_intent'],'measured':measurement,
       'method':'saved original body centers, finite curb nearest point and crosswalk polygon',
       'tolerance':'engineering source agreement only; no legal tolerance',
       'matched':False,'physical_cause_confirmed':False,
       'cause_evidence':saved['sources_sha256']}
    result={'case_id':scene['case_id'],'measured_values':measurement,
       'target_checks':[target],'setup_confirmed':False,'behavior_attempted':False,
       'maneuver_completed':False,'termination_reason':'Saved source assessment pending',
       'physical_failure_flags':[],'trace_reference':'trace.jsonl',
       'video_references':[name+'.mkv' for name in ('overview','approach','reference_corner','driver_reference')],
       'video_frame_map_reference':'video_frames.jsonl','recording_description':description,
       'recording_evidence':evidence,'realized_observables':{}}
    return report,result


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--attempt',required=True);parser.add_argument('--output',required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args();root=Path(args.attempt).resolve()
    report,result=build_report(root)
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, write_result
    result=physical_result(root,result)
    write_result(root,result)
    report['physical_checks']=result['physical_checks']
    report['realized_observables']=result['realized_observables']
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'case_id':report['case_id'],'analysis_complete':True,
                      'diagnostic_fixture':report['diagnostic_fixture']}))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

class OfflineBundleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_bundle(self):
        root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        scene=json.loads((root/'scene.json').read_text())
        config=json.loads((root/'config.json').read_text())
        self.assertEqual(check_scene(root/'scene.json',root/'candidate-crossing.xodr')['case_id'],config['selected_case_id'])
        self.assertEqual(config['duration_s'],20)
        self.assertEqual(config['required_atoms'],[])
        self.assertEqual(config['source_packets'],[])
        self.assertGreater(validate_scene(scene)['route_length_m'],5)

if __name__=='__main__': unittest.main()
